<script>
(function(){
  try {
    var p = window.location.pathname || "";
    var s = window.location.search || "";
    var h = window.location.hash || "";

    function goReplace(u){ window.location.replace(u); }
    // Preserve legacy contact links while the canonical indexed route remains /contact.
    if (p === "/contact-form" || p === "/contact-form/") { goReplace("/contact" + s + h); return; }

    // Official merchandise store: retire the broken Wix all-products destination.
    if (/^\/category\/all-products\/?$/.test(p)) { goReplace("https://gatorbait2026.itemorder.com/shop/home/"); return; }

    // 1. Legacy post prefix - biggest bug for subscribers
    if (p.indexOf("/gatorbait-media-blogs/post/") === 0) {
      goReplace(p.replace("/gatorbait-media-blogs/post/", "/post/") + s + h); return;
    }
    // 2. /blog/ -> /post/
    if (/^\/blog\/[^/]+/.test(p)) {
      var mb = p.match(/^\/blog\/(.+)$/);
      if (mb) { goReplace("/post/" + mb[1] + s + h); return; }
    }
    // 3. /category/{slug} and /categories/{slug} -> /gatorbait-media-blogs/categories/{slug}
    var mCat = p.match(/^\/categor(?:y|ies)\/(.+)$/);
    if (mCat) {
      var catSlug = mCat[1];
      if (catSlug === "buddys-blog" || catSlug === "buddy-blog") catSlug = "buddy-s-blog";
      goReplace("/gatorbait-media-blogs/categories/" + catSlug + s + h); return;
    }
    // 4. Fix buddys-blog even inside blog category path
    if (p === "/gatorbait-media-blogs/categories/buddys-blog" || p === "/gatorbait-media-blogs/categories/buddy-blog") {
      goReplace("/gatorbait-media-blogs/categories/buddy-s-blog" + s + h); return;
    }
    // 5. /tag/{slug} -> /gatorbait-media-blogs/tags/{slug}
    var mTag = p.match(/^\/tag\/(.+)$/);
    if (mTag) { goReplace("/gatorbait-media-blogs/tags/" + mTag[1] + s + h); return; }
    // 6. /plans-pricing -> /pricing-plans (subscribe funnel)
    if (p === "/plans-pricing" || p === "/plans-pricing/") {
      goReplace("/pricing-plans" + s + h); return;
    }
    // 7. /home -> / (dedupe)
    if (p === "/home") { goReplace("/" + s + h); return; }
    // 8. /signin -> /account/my-account (Wix members flow)
    if (p === "/signin" || p === "/sign-in" || p === "/login") {
      goReplace("/account/my-account" + s + h); return;
    }

    // === POST PAGE META / SCHEMA INJECTOR ===
    var isPost = (p.indexOf("/gatorbait-media-blogs/post/") === 0) || (p.indexOf("/post/") === 0);
    if (!isPost) return;

    function setMeta(attr, name, value) {
      if (!value) return;
      var sel = 'meta[' + attr + '="' + name + '"]';
      var el = document.querySelector(sel);
      if (!el) { el = document.createElement("meta"); el.setAttribute(attr, name); document.head.appendChild(el); }
      el.setAttribute("content", value);
    }
    function getMeta(name, attr) {
      attr = attr || "property";
      var el = document.querySelector('meta[' + attr + '="' + name + '"]');
      return el ? el.content : null;
    }

    setMeta("property", "og:type", "article");
    setMeta("name", "twitter:card", "summary_large_image");

    function slugToHeadline(slug){
      if(!slug) return "";
      slug = slug.replace(/[-_]/g, " ").replace(/\.[a-z]{2,4}$/i, "");
      return slug.replace(/\b\w/g, function(c){return c.toUpperCase();});
    }
    var slug = (p.match(/\/post\/([^/?#]+)/) || [])[1] || "";
    var slugHeadline = slugToHeadline(decodeURIComponent(slug));

    if (slugHeadline) {
      document.title = slugHeadline + " | GatorBait Media";
      setMeta("property", "og:title", slugHeadline);
      setMeta("name", "twitter:title", slugHeadline);
    }

    var injected = false;
    function injectAll() {
      var h1 = document.querySelector("h1");
      var headline = (h1 && h1.innerText && h1.innerText.trim()) || "";
      if (!headline) { headline = document.title.replace(/\s*\|\s*GatorBait Media.*$/i, "").trim(); }
      if (!headline || /^GatorBait Media/i.test(headline)) headline = slugHeadline;
      if (!headline) return false;

      var siteDesc = "GatorBait Media is the premier source for Florida Gators news, founded by Emmy-winning journalist and NY Times best-selling author Buddy Martin. Covering UF athletics since 1979.";
      var existingOgDesc = getMeta("og:description");
      var existingMetaDesc = getMeta("description", "name");
      var desc;
      if (existingOgDesc && existingOgDesc !== siteDesc) { desc = existingOgDesc; }
      else if (existingMetaDesc && existingMetaDesc !== siteDesc) { desc = existingMetaDesc; }
      else { desc = "GatorBait Media coverage of Florida Gators and SEC athletics: " + headline + "."; }
      desc = desc.substring(0, 250);

      var newTitle = headline + " | GatorBait Media";
      if (document.title !== newTitle) { document.title = newTitle; }
      setMeta("property", "og:title", headline);
      setMeta("property", "og:type", "article");
      setMeta("property", "og:description", desc);
      setMeta("name", "description", desc);
      setMeta("name", "twitter:card", "summary_large_image");
      setMeta("name", "twitter:title", headline);
      setMeta("name", "twitter:description", desc);

      injected = true; return true; /* GBM: duplicate NewsArticle removed - gbm-news-ld is canonical */
      var url = (window.location.origin + window.location.pathname).replace(/\/+$/, "");
      var img = getMeta("og:image") || "https://static.wixstatic.com/media/ae876a_33367cf1645c43d18b0d930a68ca747b~mv2.png";
      var published = getMeta("article:published_time") || new Date().toISOString();
      var modified = getMeta("article:modified_time") || published;
      var author = getMeta("article:author") || "GatorBait Staff";
      var section = getMeta("article:section") || "Florida Gators";
      var schema = {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"NewsArticle","@id":url+"#article","mainEntityOfPage":{"@type":"WebPage","@id":url},"url":url,"headline":headline.substring(0,110),"description":desc,"image":[img],"datePublished":published,"dateModified":modified,"author":{"@type":"Person","name":author},"publisher":{"@id":"https://www.gatorbaitmedia.com/#organization"},"articleSection":section,"isAccessibleForFree":true,"inLanguage":"en-US"};
      var s2 = document.createElement("script"); s2.type = "application/ld+json"; s2.id = "gbm-na-ld"; s2.textContent = JSON.stringify(schema); document.head.appendChild(s2);
      injected = true;
      return true;
    }

    injectAll();

    function startObserver() {
      if (!document.body) { setTimeout(startObserver, 50); return; }
      var obs = new MutationObserver(function(mutations, observer){
        if (injectAll() && injected) {
          setTimeout(function(){ injectAll(); observer.disconnect(); }, 500);
        }
      });
      obs.observe(document.body, {childList: true, subtree: true});
      setTimeout(function(){ obs.disconnect(); }, 15000);
    }
    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", startObserver);
    } else {
      startObserver();
    }
    setTimeout(injectAll, 500);
    setTimeout(injectAll, 1500);
    setTimeout(injectAll, 3500);
  } catch(e) {}
})();
</script>
